title: Deeper/broader native-CAD acceptance and OpenCADStudio issue reconciliation

sources.fact: GitHub release v2026.41 is associated with source revision cff240e.
The exact release lockfile is the dependency-pin artifact to capture before any optional application run.
ACadRust identifies OpenCADStudio as a consumer of its DWG/DXF engine, supporting classification as a correlated application route rather than an independent parser.

An open issue reports initial AutoCAD/ProgeCAD failures for 3D DWG output; later comments describe improvement in version 50 and a specific current-main boolean output accepted by an unnamed strict third-party DWG reader. This is not AutoCAD/ProgeCAD acceptance evidence.

A hatch/polyline recovery report was closed after a maintainer reported that a current-main 2018 DWG opened without errors in an unnamed strict third-party reader and LibreDWG reported no errors; the report does not publish named-reader identity, reproducible hashes, or native AutoCAD acceptance.
The README advertises native DWG/DXF and ACIS entity tessellation; this feature statement does not specify exact entity-family coverage, carrier joins, B-rep validity, or full-fidelity behavior.
The project page describes v2026.39 while GitHub's release list identifies v2026.41, demonstrating source-surface freshness skew.

disposition.peerLineage: ACadRust-related application route; not an independent DWG/DXF parser vote
disposition.implementationImpact: Refine the existing composed consumer/native acceptance checkpoint only; no new finding, subplan, dependency, CTest, fixture, or local support promotion.
acceptanceFieldsToKeepSeparate: B-rep/kernel validity and independent analytic geometry comparison
